claims.text: Replace forward-reference string constants by the expression they spell.
claims.why: The function checks for ast.Constant with string value and parses it recursively.

claims.text: x: "Later" and x: Later mean the same thing and must produce the same text
claims.why: The function replaces the string with the parsed expression, so both become the same AST.

claims.text: Two places are deliberately left alone: Literal["a"], whose strings are VALUES and would become a type called a, and every Annotated[...] argument after the first, which is metadata and not a type at all.
claims.why: The code checks for tail 'Literal' and returns early; for 'Annotated' it only destrings the first element of the slice tuple.

claims.text: RAW annotation text for one ast annotation slot ("" when absent).
claims.why: The function returns '' if node is None, otherwise returns ast.unparse of destringed deepcopy.

claims.text: ast.unparse rather than a source slice, so the whitespace of dict[str,Item] and dict[str, Item] canonicalizes to one string and two files that mean the same thing are counted once.
claims.why: The function uses ast.unparse which produces canonical output; the code does exactly that.

claims.text: The node is COPIED before de-stringifying, because the caller's tree is shared with the unit and import walks and must not be mutated under them.
claims.why: The function calls copy.deepcopy(node) before passing to _destring.

claims.text: Nominal names in a position the element rule discards (mapping keys, Callable parameters). Structural vocabulary is filtered out, so dict[str, X] drops str and not also dict.
claims.why: The function checks for _NONE_NAMES, _ANY_NAMES, _STRUCTURAL_NAMES and only drops if not in those sets.
The constants _NONE_NAMES, _ANY_NAMES, _STRUCTURAL_NAMES are not defined in this chunk.

observations.what: The function _destring handles Literal and Annotated specially; Annotated only destrings the first element of a tuple slice.
The function _collect handles None by setting saw_none flag, and string constants by parsing and recursing; non-string constants are ignored.
The function _gather_dropped uses _NONE_NAMES, _ANY_NAMES, _STRUCTURAL_NAMES which are not defined in this chunk.
